subject: Summit delegate travel — airmatrix convergence
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: K. Ramos <kramos@novum.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Summit travel — initial gap matrix and ask

Team,

Attached is v3 of the delegate manifest; booking audit found 6 delegates with a >3h connection gap into Portland on Day 0. Two of those are execs (see row highlights). Options from our side:
- Ask travel partner to rebook to earlier SFO->PDX waves where seats are available
- Consolidate delegates on the same carrier into a single PNR and hold standby for one earlier leg
- Buy targeted aisle/premium seats for the execs if rebooking causes long layovers

Can Travel Ops (K. Ramos) confirm: availability for reroutes on the 18:00 and 19:45 SFO->PDX flights, and estimated cost delta for two aisle upgrades?

Attachment: redwood_delegate_manifest_v3.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks,
Monica
Travel Programs
Redwood Inference
From: K. Ramos <kramos@novum.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Travel Concierge <travel@conciergeco.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit travel — initial gap matrix and ask

Hi Monica / team,

Thanks — reviewed the manifest. Quick options we can lock immediately:
1) Rebook four delegates onto United UA1456 (SFO 18:00 -> PDX 19:32) — seats available on hold for 48h. No change fee for one PNR, fare delta ~ $120 per pax.
2) Move two execs to Delta DL428 (SFO 16:25 -> PDX 17:57) — single-seat availability (premium aisle), fare delta ~ $320 each.

If you want the aisle seats purchased now we can process a card authorization. Otherwise we can hold the seats for 24h and release. I've attached our confirmation summary.

Attachment: concierge_confirmations.pdf (PDF)

Please confirm which option you want us to action and whether to incur the aisle upgrades. We'll also flag any passengers with tight connections for ETA watch.

Best,
K. Ramos
Senior Ops, Novum Travel Partners
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit travel — initial gap matrix and ask

Quick priorities from program side:
- Exec priority list (must be on earliest possible arrival):
  • Priya N. (VIP) — aisle preference, vegetarian meal
  • Rafael M. — aisle, needs wheelchair assistance at PDX
  • Two senior PMs — flexible

If Markus signs off on aisle upgrades for the two execs I recommend we do Delta DL428 purchase now to avoid downstream churn. Otherwise go with the UA1456 consolidation for the remaining delegates.

Note: HubSpot opp HUB-489217 is flagged as high-impact; any delay will ripple into the first-day schedule.

-L

Lauren Bishop
Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 14:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Summit travel — initial gap matrix and ask

If rebooking/aisle upgrades are blocked for any reason we should land a contingency: overnight room + charter transfer for late arrivals. Cost estimate I ran (back-of-envelope): $280 per pax for one-night room + $1,200 charter uplift (shared across up to 8 pax).

Monica — can you confirm how many pax would need overnight and whether guests have company-card coverage for last-minute hotels? I'll align finance if we need an exception. See itinerary draft in the shared Drive link.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D5E6F_page_itinerary

-Vivek
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, K. Ramos <kramos@novum.com>, Travel Concierge <travel@conciergeco.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Summit travel — initial gap matrix and ask

Thanks everyone — decision below.

1) Approve aisle/premium seat purchase for the two execs (Delta DL428) up to $500 total. Travel Ops, please process the payment and confirm PNRs.
2) For the remaining delegates, lock United UA1456 holds for 48h and proceed with consolidation into as few PNRs as sensible.
3) If any delegate is forced into >6h layover as a result, execute the overnight+charter contingency; Vivek please work with Finance on the exception if needed.

Monica — once K. Ramos confirms I want the final manifest uploaded (final_manifest.pdf) and the Drive folder updated. Call out any passengers requiring assistance so ground team is briefed.

On Tue, Apr 3, 2028 at 10:05 AM K. Ramos <kramos@novum.com> wrote:
> Hi Monica / team,
> 
> Thanks — reviewed the manifest. Quick options we can lock immediately...

Markus Klein
